# Cambridge University Press

> Cambridge Core is a premier academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals and research across disciplines including macroeconomics, monetary policy, and economic research.

Cambridge University Press maintains Cambridge Core as a digital repository for scholarly journals and academic content. The platform serves researchers, academics, and institutions seeking high-quality peer-reviewed publications and economic research.

## Key Topics

- Macroeconomic Dynamics

## Economics & Macroeconomics Journals

- [Macroeconomic Dynamics](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/macroeconomic-dynamics): Peer-reviewed academic journal on macroeconomics and monetary policy edited by William A. Barnett, publishing cutting-edge economic research and analysis.
